I had my Right Eye Cataract Surgery on 18th of July 2026. Dr Ankita Bisani performed the Surgery. The ambience , the handholding, the interaction and post surgery accommodating in a Deluxe Room needs worth mentioning.
It was an excellent experience .The Surgery was very smooth with frequent interactions with Doctor.
Today the Review process too was just class.
Really amazing that in today’s scenario this hospital really gives the best care and it’s economical too. The staff all were very well mannered.
Needs special mention of Mr Muniasamy Manager (Corporate Relations) for his support.
Wishing all the best to the entire Team.
Thanx
Shriram K S T
RTD
State Bank of India
